newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks edge up pulled by Electricidad.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks edge up pulled by Electricidad.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed mixed, although the 19 share index edged ahead a hair on continued gains by market bellwether Electricidad de Caracas, traders said.
"Electricidad led the session and the stock's hot, with some foreign demand," said Banesco broker Simon Brad.
Electricidad closed up 2.50 bolivars at 531.00 as 3.8 million shares traded -- one fifth of the day's total volume -- on widely expected tariff increases that will benefit the company's bottom line.
The bolsa's IBC index gained 0.16 percent to end at 6,336.52 points, while Merinvest's composite .MRCP index -- which includes telephone company CANTV -- closed broadly flat at 97.37 points.

Other than Electricidad "most share prices were fairly stable," said Brad. Interest in Sudamtex B shares remained high, however, on news U.S.-based financier George Soros acquired 20 percent of the textile company Monday.
The stock closed up 0.25 bolivars at 40.00 as 2.5 million shares exchanged hands.
Among traded issues, 13 rose, 18 fell and seven ended even in total trade volume of 19.5 million shares worth 3.4 billion bolivars ($7 million).
